flags.why: “Ra khỏi” means to leave or get out of somewhere; “to take out of” requires another verb such as “lấy”.
flags.fix: to leave; to get out of

flags.why: “Ranh con” is a contemptuous insult toward a child or younger person, as described in [VDict](https://vdict.com/ranh%20con%2C3%2C0%2C0.html).
“Rau mùi” is mainly the Northern name for coriander, as confirmed by [Sức khỏe & Đời sống](https://suckhoedoisong.vn/rau-mui-de-phong-chua-benh-16935547.htm).
“Rau nhút” is mainly the Southern name for this vegetable, as confirmed by [VnExpress](https://vnexpress.net/canh-bun-hai-mien-4065320.html).
